pedagogical_depth.justification: Strict L4 met. All five lessons carry expanded_walkthrough blocks of 4000+ chars covering title/rationale/setup/teacher_script/expected_student_responses (4 bands)/common_misconceptions (3 each, paired with concrete recovery_moves). Lesson 1 includes the strategy-scale mismatch repair (chunk-by-tens upgrade); Lesson 2 includes the tape-diagram-as-structure repair; Lesson 3 includes the multiplication-as-grouping understanding repair; Lesson 4 includes the fraction-as-whole-number error repair (treating 1/2 as 2); Lesson 5 includes the build-to-equation translation repair. Five distinct worksheet response_types: write, draw_or_write, circle_or_loop, match (implicit in fact-family triangles), self_rate. Mid-unit formative gate (Multiplication Check-In after Lesson 3) AND unit-level reflection sheet (5 prompts) both present.

instructional_balance.justification: Strict L4 met. CRA progression spans the whole week: concrete (paper kittens in baskets, paper cookies with halves and fourths, snap cubes, two-colour counters) → representational (double ten-frames, tape diagrams, array grids, fact-family triangles) → abstract (equations, multiplication notation, division notation, fact-family symbolic forms). Lesson 3 'Equal Groups — Mae's Multiplication Move' is the keystone for B2.5; Lesson 4 'Half-Groups and Fourth-Groups' extends to fractional groups; Lesson 5 'Equal Sharing — Dan's Division Move' integrates B2.6 with the multiplication-division partner relationship.
evidence_refs: 3_manipulatives.json::assets (13 manipulatives + 3 character puppets spanning all three CRA tiers)

clarity_communication.justification: Strict L4 met. All five lessons have expanded_walkthrough blocks with substantial teacher_script (≥3000 chars dialogue), 4 expected_student_responses bands (Confused/Mid/Strong/Stretched), and 3 misconceptions paired with concrete recovery_moves. Every lesson has student_learning_goal starting with 'I can'. Teacher scripts use embodied gestures (the chunk-by-tens whiteboard motion, the basket placement of kittens, the half-cookie cut, the cookie deal-out) so the script is enactable, not just readable.
